## Objective 

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Visualization

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
#load files for environment

library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# Load the processed CSV
fleet <- read_csv("data/fleet_chnms_2017_2024.csv")

# Load boundary again as sf
boundary <- st_read("data/chnms_designated_boundary/CHNMS_py.shp") %>%
  st_transform(4326)

# Convert fleet CSV back to sf for plotting
fleet_sf <- st_as_sf(fleet, coords = c("cell_ll_lon", "cell_ll_lat"), crs = 4326)

#need to aggregate by fishing hours by lat long
fleet_agg_fishing <- fleet %>%
  group_by(cell_ll_lat, cell_ll_lon) %>%
  summarise(total_hours = sum(fishing_hours, na.rm = TRUE))

#aggregrate by gear type with fishing hours
fleet_agg_gear <- fleet %>%
  group_by(geartype)|>
  summarise(
    total_fishing_hours = sum(fishing_hours, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
#aggregate gear type by season
fleet_agg_gear_month <- fleet_sf |>
  st_drop_geometry()|>
  group_by(geartype, month) |>
  summarise(
    total_fishing_hours = sum(fishing_hours, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop" #remove all grouping now that we dropped
  )
```

```{r}

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = boundary, fill = NA, color = "black") +
  geom_point(data = fleet_agg, aes(x = cell_ll_lon, y = cell_ll_lat, size = total_hours),
             color = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Aggregated fishing effort by location")
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = boundary, fill = NA, color = "black") +
  stat_bin_2d(data = fleet, aes(x = cell_ll_lon, y = cell_ll_lat, weight = fishing_hours),
              bins = 30) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Fishing effort density (heatmap)")
```

```{r}
ggplot()+
geom_col(data = fleet_agg_gear,(aes(x = reorder (geartype, -total_fishing_hours),y = total_fishing_hours)
         ))+
  labs(
    x = "Fishing gear type",
    y = "Total fishing hours",
    title = "Total fishing effort by gear type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

Gear types with zero hours reflect the absence of AIS-detected effort within the study area and do not imply the absence of fishing activity.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)

ggplot() +
  geom_col(
    data = fleet_agg_gear,
    aes(
      x = total_fishing_hours,
      y = reorder(geartype, total_fishing_hours)
    ),
    fill = "#6B7C8A",
    width = 0.6,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "AIS-detected fishing effort by gear type",
    subtitle = "Chumash Heritage National Marine Sanctuary",
    x = "Total Fishing Hours",
    y = NULL
  ) 
```

ridge plot

```{r}

library(ggridges)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)


# Seasonal color scheme (blues to oranges across the year)
ggplot(fleet_agg_gear_month,
       aes(x = month,
           y = reorder(geartype, total_fishing_hours, FUN = sum),
           fill = after_stat(x))) +
  geom_density_ridges_gradient(
    scale = 3.2,
    rel_min_height = 0.01,
    alpha = 0.9,
    color = "#1a1a1a",
    size = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:12,
    labels = month.abb,
    expand = c(0.01, 0)
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#3B5F8F", "#5A8CAE", "#7FB8D4", "#A8D5E2",
               "#FFD580", "#FFA040"),
    name = "Month"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Seasonal fishing effort by gear type",
    subtitle = "Central California · Cool colors = winter/spring, warm colors = summer/fall",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Data: Global Fishing Watch AIS"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#FCFCFA", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#FCFCFA", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "lines"),
    
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 17,
      face = "bold",
      color = "#0D1B2A",
      hjust = 0,
      margin = margin(b = 3)
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 10,
      color = "#5A6670",
      hjust = 0,
      margin = margin(b = 18)
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 8,
      color = "#888888",
      hjust = 1,
      margin = margin(t = 12)
    ),
    
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      color = "#0D1B2A",
      size = 10,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 1,
      margin = margin(r = 10)
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      color = "#5A6670",
      size = 12,
      margin = margin(t = 5)
    ),
    
    plot.margin = margin(25, 25, 15, 25)
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(fleet_agg_gear_month, aes(x = month, y = geartype, fill = total_fishing_hours)) +
  geom_tile(color = NA) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#AAB4BE", high = "#2F3A44") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:12,
    labels = c("J","F","M","A","M","J","J","A","S","O","N","D")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Seasonal AIS-detected fishing effort by gear type",
    subtitle = "Central California",
    x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Fishing hours"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#F7F6F3", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F7F6F3", color = NA),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "#5A6670"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "#2F3A44")
  )
```
